Evidence: Kejriwal ki sarkar ne education aur health me achievements kiye hain, jo har volunteer aur supporter ki achievement hai (Source 1). AAP ne sirf paanch saal me kaafi kuch achieve kiya hai, aur Kejriwal ko party ka face mana jata hai (Source 2). Punjab me teachers ke liye 'Teacher Transfer' policy ko badalne ka guarantee diya gaya hai (Source 3).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se ye pata chalta hai ki Kejriwal ki sarkar ne education aur health me achievements kiye hain, jo claim ko support karta hai. Source 1 me yeh kaha gaya hai ki AAP ki achievements har volunteer ki bhi achievements hain. Source 2 me AAP ke achievements ko highlight kiya gaya hai, jo Kejriwal ki leadership me hui hain. Isliye, evidence claim ki core assertion ko support karta hai.
